title: SERA-Float: A Soft Error Resilient Approximate Floating-Point Computing Format
extraction_scope: HAL manuscript PDF pages 4–9: format, split-code correction condition, injected faults, applications and synthesized hardware; Tables VIII and IX visually checked. Not experimental reproduction.

source_history.scope: Initial institutional summary and bibliography identity; superseded in evidence depth by manuscript recovery, not independent confirmation of results.

identity.manuscript_access: Public document downloaded successfully after web-reader failure; HAL cover identifies version 1 submitted 2025-10-27.

pdf_verification.page_numbering: One-based PDF pages, including HAL cover

format.limit: Mantissa compression frees protection bits inside a 32-bit representation; not a reduction of stored word width below FP32.

correction.two_bit_condition: One flip in each protected half; arbitrary two flips in one codeword are not covered by the stated correction guarantee.
correction.mantissa: Single-bit parity detection, not mantissa error correction
correction.locator: Section III.B and Figure 2, PDF pages 4–5

faults.scope: F1 single-bit events; F2 adds spatial double-bit events. Section IV.A injects storage faults at any location across the representation.
faults.locator: Table IV PDF page 4; Section IV.A PDF page 6
faults.limit: Injected model; not a measured device fault distribution or proof for arbitrary spatial/temporal faults. Equal injection percentages do not by themselves establish equal physical failure exposure across word widths.

dnn.locator: Section IV.B and Table VIII, PDF page 8
dnn.limit: Author-reported accuracy, not reproduced; held-out split, training/checkpoint provenance and injection implementation require verification. Text's 0.9% loss does not specify the percentage-point convention.

hardware.locator: Section IV.C PDF pages 8–9; Figure 4(c) PDF page 6; Table IX PDF page 9
hardware.candidate: Multiplication framework enabled by SERA-Float conversion, Figure 4(c)
hardware.limit: Headline 80.3% is consistent with displayed power-times-delay arithmetic, not the rounded energy-column ratio. Unrounded values and per-module conversion/inverse/ECC accounting are not established. Reported delays exceed the stated 1 ns synthesis constraint; do not infer timing closure or 1 GHz throughput. No system-memory or whole-inference energy result.

mechanism: Approximate floating-point representation protects sign/exponent with error correction, retains eight valid mantissa bits, and tracks exception-sensitive bits.

reported_claims.energy: Up to 80.3% energy saving per multiplication
reported_claims.accuracy: 0.9% DNN inference accuracy reduction; percentage-point convention unresolved

limits: Per-multiplication energy is not whole-system or full-inference energy.
Fault model and synthesis conditions are extracted, but injection implementation, physical calibration and per-module overhead accounting remain unverified.
Exception-avoidance summary does not establish immunity to arbitrary faults.
Selected manuscript extraction is not experimental reproduction or independent acceptance.
FP8 is labeled E3M4 in format comparisons but E4M3 in Table VIII; do not silently harmonize these configurations.
next_action: Prepare conservative mechanism coding and original-source review capture with HAL-cover handling; seek artifact/injection and synthesis accounting details. Keep headline metrics unaccepted pending independent review.
